text.en: A mother's snack for her child's friends is where Tamil hospitality begins.

This prose lesson says that Tamil hospitality begins with the snack a mother gives to a friend who comes along with her son or daughter. In Tamil tradition, cooking mixed feeling with food, and a feast expressed culture.
The lesson praises welcoming guests (விருந்தோம்பல்), a core Tamil value in literature from Thirukkural onwards.
Terms: விருந்து (feast or guest), விருந்தோம்பல் (hospitality), பண்பாடு (culture) and உணவு (food).
